## What this region is

How the init script (the project setup TUI) is built and where it is going: one config state read from and re-read after every step, progress flags as the record of what is done ("restart clears, continue resumes", "just a boolean per step"), derived view state, the init/ layout and the recipe for a new task view, plus the cut-over to headless and from to migrations at launch. Anyone asking "does the setup script guide the user through every step", "re-read the config between steps", "where does the init config live", "the status flashes wrong on mount" or "show all the steps upfront" is here. Writing one provider step is.

## What it exists for

- Read project config or secrets in the init script
- Make an init step safe to rerun
- Call provider CLIs or APIs from init and wait for readiness
- Track init setup progress and UI state
- Test init provider workflows without real calls

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Get my schema change into the database → database-tooling
- Only do this in prod → environments-deploy
- Encrypt or decrypt a stored secret field → encryption
